电脑正在显示棕褐色卡牌对战游戏，包含人物头像、中央对战区域以及红绿色卡牌。女主身体微微前倾，右手握鼠标，完全没有察觉背后有人。 偷拍者突然在她耳后近距离问： “哎！你干啥呢？” 女主被吓得肩膀猛然耸起，身体明显向前缩紧，右手从鼠标上弹开。她快速回头，眼睛睁大，恐惧而心虚地看向镜头。 偷拍者也因她突然回头而本能后退半步，画面发生一次明显后撤和轻微倾斜。 2–4秒｜越肩压近，第一次切屏失败 偷拍者看到网页内容后停止移动一瞬间，镜头只剩下呼吸造成的轻微上下浮动。随后传出震惊的倒吸气声： “嘶——” 女主更加害怕，急忙左右移动身体挡住屏幕。偷拍者为了继续看清内容，从她肩膀侧面不断探头，镜头跟随双方的遮挡动作产生真实的左右摇摆。 4–6秒｜第一人称绕到侧面，第二次切屏更加可疑 女主看到警告页面后明显更加惊恐。她弓起身体挡住显示器，一只手拍击键盘，另一只手试图关闭页面。她不断看向屏幕、镜头和桌面，显然正在寻找其他遮挡物。 偷拍者疑惑地向前靠近，镜头略微歪斜，画外男声迟疑地说： “你这……” 6–7.5秒｜第一人称突然蹲低，捕捉腿脚慌乱 女主慌张地伸手去拿桌上的牛皮纸笔记本。 偷拍者察觉她可能正在藏东西，立即蹲下。手机镜头随身体快速下坠，从正常站立高度降到距离地面约20厘米。 下降过程中，桌面边缘、办公椅和女主身体快速掠过镜头。画面进入桌下阴影，自动曝光短暂提亮，自动对焦出现一次迟疑。 低视点主观镜头位于女主双脚斜前方约一米处。前景是她的鞋、快速调整位置的双腿和办公椅滚轮；中景是桌腿；上方只能看见她前倾身体的局部轮廓。桌面被桌板完全遮挡，此时看不到笔记本和手机。 女主因为肌肉记忆，下意识用食指在手机屏幕上向上刷动两次。第一次滑动自然连续，第二次滑动后，她的手指突然僵在屏幕上方。 偷拍者和女主同时停止动作。画面短暂停稳，只剩下压抑的呼吸浮动。 9.5–12秒｜从手机抬向脸部，害怕转为绝望 焦点首先

en.content: 15-Second AI Video Full Prompt | Entire video in first-person covert “checking up on an employee” perspective Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, the entire video is only the covert filmer’s phone in first-person subjective view. Unprocessed iPhone handheld real-shoot texture, a typical small Chinese office, cool white overhead lights, auto exposure, auto focus, auto white balance. Preserve real footstep impact, breathing rise and fall, wrist corrections, composition overshoot, brief defocus, screen moiré, chromatic aberration at the edges, and motion blur caused by fast movement. No gimbal feel, no cinematic camera moves, no filters, no color grading, no skin smoothing. Filmer character setup The filmer is a male supervisor who suspects a female employee may be slacking off at work, so he quietly approaches her from behind through the office aisle with his phone raised, trying to capture evidence. The camera is the supervisor’s eyes. The filmer himself never appears in the video, and there are no cuts to a third-person objective angle. All movement must correspond to the filmer’s real bodily actions: tiptoeing closer, suddenly leaning out, peeking over her shoulder at the computer, moving to the side, crouching to observe, standing up to get closer to the desk, and instinctively stepping back after being discovered by the female lead. The protagonist is a 20-year-old adult East Asian woman, wearing black fitted pants and thin-rim glasses hf_20260724_043758_2a03cd57-50fe-4045-b1d5-c1f63e1cb54a. Her emotions must change strictly in the following order: unaware slacking off → startled by a voice from behind → scared and guilty → panicked screen switching and blocking → despair after the phone is exposed → stops explaining → cold, detached “giving up” mode. Mermaid-style posing may only appear in the final “giving up” stage; in the first half she must not be calm, sexy, or deliberately posing. 0–2 seconds | First-person sneaking up from behind The first shot begins in the office aisle about three meters behind the female lead. The filmer holds up the phone and quickly approaches her workstation with light steps. The phone stays at chest height, and the camera produces slight vertical jolts and left-right sway with each step. The frame first shows her back, the office chair, and the back of the monitor; the computer content is not yet visible. The filmer closes to about one meter behind her right side, leans his body to the right, and suddenly peeks out from behind her right shoulder. The camera forms a close over-the-shoulder view, showing her side profile, right hand, keyboard, and computer screen at the same time. The computer is displaying a sepia-toned card battle game, including character avatars, a central battle area, and red and green cards. The female lead is leaning slightly forward, right hand on the mouse, completely unaware that someone is behind her. The filmer suddenly asks close to her ear: “Hey! What are you doing?” She is so startled that her shoulders jerk upward, her body visibly tightens forward, and her right hand springs off the mouse. She quickly turns back, eyes wide, looking at the camera with fear and guilt. The filmer also instinctively steps back half a step because of her sudden turn, causing a noticeable backward shift and slight tilt in the frame. 2–4 seconds | Over-the-shoulder push-in, first screen switch fails The female lead immediately turns back to the computer, hurriedly grabs the mouse, and rapidly presses keys with her left hand. The filmer leans forward again, and the camera presses in from above her right shoulder toward the monitor. Her panicked side profile sits in the left foreground, while the computer screen fills most of the right side. The computer suddenly switches from the card game to a dark image waterfall webpage. The page is filled with male fitness photos, muscular men, and handsome cover images. After seeing the wrong page, her pupils tighten, her lips part slightly, and her body freezes. She immediately leans forward, using her shoulders and back to block part of the monitor. After seeing the webpage content, the filmer stops moving for a moment, and the camera is left with only the slight up-and-down motion caused by breathing. Then comes a shocked intake of breath: “Hiss—” She becomes even more frightened and quickly shifts her body left and right to block the screen. To keep seeing the content, the filmer keeps peeking from the side of her shoulder, and the camera follows the blocking motion of both people with real left-right swaying. 4–6 seconds | First-person moves to the side, second screen switch becomes even more suspicious The filmer takes a quick step to the right and moves around to the side of the workstation. As the camera passes her shoulder and the edge of the monitor, it is briefly blocked, with obvious motion blur and one autofocus search during the movement. From the side subjective angle, the frame shows her tense side profile, both hands rapidly typing, and the computer screen. She is breathing fast, her left hand keeps hitting the wrong keys, and her right hand moves the mouse in a flustered way. The computer switches again to a black warning page, with a striking red-and-white English title at the top: “FBI WARNING” Below the title are multiple lines of white English warning text. After seeing the warning page, she becomes visibly more terrified. She hunches her body to block the monitor, slaps at the keyboard with one hand, and tries to close the page with the other. She keeps looking at the screen, the camera, and the desk, clearly searching for something else to hide behind. The filmer leans forward in confusion, the camera tilting slightly, and a hesitant male voice off-screen says: “What are you…” 6–7.5 seconds | First-person suddenly crouches low, capturing her panicked legs The female lead nervously reaches for the kraft-paper notebook on the desk. Sensing that she may be hiding something, the filmer immediately crouches. The phone camera drops rapidly with his body, from normal standing height to about 20 cm above the floor. During the descent, the desk edge, office chair, and the female lead’s body sweep quickly past the lens. The frame enters the shadow under the desk, the auto exposure briefly brightens, and autofocus hesitates once. The low-angle subjective shot is about one meter diagonally in front of her feet. In the foreground are her shoes, her legs shifting position quickly, and the office chair wheels; in the midground are the desk legs; above, only part of her forward-leaning body outline is visible. The desktop is completely blocked by the desk board, so the notebook and phone cannot be seen at this moment. Because of her nerves, she suddenly pulls one leg back, and one foot almost hits the camera. The filmer instinctively dodges backward, causing a quick retreat and left-right shake in the frame. Her other toe taps the floor in a hurry, her knee bumps the desk board, and the office chair slides back a few centimeters. You can hear the soft sounds of shoe soles scraping, chair wheels rolling, and knee hitting the desk. 7.5–9.5 seconds | The filmer suddenly stands up and discovers the phone under the notebook From the low angle, the female lead’s body is seen leaning forward, but it is impossible to tell what she is holding. The filmer immediately rises from the crouch. The phone camera moves rapidly upward with his body, tracking up along her shoes, legs, chair seat, lower back, and arms. The desk edge quickly drops from the top of the frame to the bottom. The standing motion carries real inertia: the camera overshoots the target height first, then corrects downward once; as the filmer stabilizes, his weight sways left and right, and auto exposure readjusts from the dark under-desk shadow to the bright desktop. The filmer takes half a step forward and peeks from the side of her right shoulder. The phone is about 40 cm above the desktop, tilted downward about 45 degrees, creating a close oblique top-down view of the desk. The female lead had intended to pick up the kraft-paper notebook and pretend to work, but in her panic she opens the pages fully. The red phone hidden under the pages is suddenly fully exposed. The phone lies face up, screen lit, showing a two-column feed of handsome men with text and images, filled with male fitness photos. Shocked, the filmer quickly leans in, bringing the camera to within about 20 cm of the phone. The movement causes a composition overshoot, and the phone briefly drifts off-center; the filmer immediately corrects left, bringing the phone back to the center of the frame. Because of muscle memory, the female lead unconsciously swipes upward on the phone screen twice with her index finger. The first swipe is smooth and continuous; after the second swipe, her finger suddenly freezes above the screen. The filmer and the female lead both stop moving at the same time. The frame briefly steadies, with only restrained breathing causing slight motion. 9.5–12 seconds | Camera lifts from the phone to her face, fear turns into despair First, the focus locks onto the male fitness photos on the phone screen. Sensing that the camera is already close, the female lead slowly raises her head. The filmer immediately lifts the phone camera from the desktop, moving along her frozen finger, arm, and tense shoulder to her face. The focus blurs briefly because of the distance change, then locks onto her eyes again
